headline: Congress named a post office in Bristol, Rhode Island, after First Sergeant P. Andrew McKenna Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 515 Hope Street in Bristol, Rhode Island. The building will now be called the First Sergeant P. Andrew McKenna Jr. Post Office. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 24, 2018.
